reviewItem.question: Does "Certain invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies that have always been ignored will now be rejected by the apiserver" mean a change to crd-field:cilium|group=cilium.io|kind=CiliumNetworkPolicy|path=spec (validation-tightened)?

proposed.statement: Invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies (multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules) that were previously ignored are now rejected by the apiserver via server-side validation.
